title: Crew graph
noTask: Pick a task to see its crew

picker.title: Recent tasks
picker.error: The task list could not be read. Check that the background service is running.
picker.empty: This project has no tasks yet. A crew appears here once you describe a task.

canvas.hint: Task → crew · standby on each step

legend.help: Drag to arrange · Alt+arrows move · right-click or Shift+F10 for actions · F full screen
legend.helpEdit: Click a step to edit it · drag from a step's right edge to another step to make it wait · right-click or Shift+F10 for actions

fact.noCandidate: no account fits; edit the crew

admission.worktree_busy: worktree in use by another step
admission.no_adapter: runner not available in this build

why.not_started: This step has not started yet
why.completed: This step finished; there is no one to read it
why.no_run: No run yet, so there is no id
why.superseded: A later run already continues this step
why.working: The agent is still working, so there is nothing to check
why.no_target: This step has no other account to hand off to
why.no_request: Nothing asks about a handoff for this step now
why.no_reset: The reset time is not known
why.last_step: A crew keeps at least one step
why.nothing_finished: No step has finished yet; a follow-up goes after a finished one
why.task_finished: The task is finished; there is nothing left to cancel
why.no_worktree: No changes yet: the task has no worktree

stop.title: Stop this agent?
stop.body: This ends {{target}} and every process it started.
stop.keeps: The worktree stays on disk. Closing a panel never does this; only this button does.

message.title: Message {{target}}
message.label: Message
message.live: The agent reads it at its next turn. Ctrl+Enter sends.
message.queued: The agent is not running now. The message waits and goes to whichever run continues this step. Ctrl+Enter sends.

done.approved: Crew approved; steps start as slots free up
done.followUp: Follow-up added. It runs after you approve it
done.waitReset: {{target}} waits for its limit to reset
done.changeProfile: {{target}} will start on the AI you picked
done.rerun: Added a run of {{target}} on another AI. It runs after you approve it
done.changeAllKept_one: AI changed on {{count}} step; the rules kept {{kept}} as before
done.changeAllKept_other: AI changed on {{count}} steps; the rules kept {{kept}} as before

error.layout: The layout could not be saved ({{code}})
error.copy: The run id could not be copied

run.not_live: That agent has no running process
run.resume_unsupported: This runner cannot resume a session
run.superseded: A later run already continues this step
run.session_changed: This step moved to another session. Check it again and retry
run.price_unknown: The model has no known price. Approve it in the Inbox first
run.still_limited: The limit is still reached. Try again after it resets.
run.fenced: This run lost its step to a handoff

crew.read_only_profile: That account is read-only and this step changes files
crew.unknown_role: That role is not available in this project
crew.self: A step cannot wait for itself
crew.exists: It already waits for that step
crew.missing: It does not wait for that step
crew.approved: That step belongs to the approved crew
crew.not_finished: A follow-up goes after a finished step
crew.last_step: A crew keeps at least one step
crew.too_many: This crew has as many steps as it can hold
crew.unknown_candidate: That account was not scored for this role
crew.independence: Two steps would use the same model, against the independence rule
crew.read_only_lease: A read-only role never gets the worktree's write lease
crew.standby_chosen: The account in use cannot also stand by
crew.standby_duplicate: That account is already in the chain
crew.no_candidate: A step has no account yet
crew.missing_profile: A step has no account yet
crew.not_approved: Skipping is for a step of the approved crew; remove this one instead
crew.best_of: This step runs as a Best of N group and keeps its place

handoff.same_profile: The step already runs on that account
handoff.open: This step is already being handed off
handoff.target_not_ready: That account is not ready: no key, not signed in, or no runner
handoff.over_cap: That account is past its spending cap
handoff.over_budget: This task is past its budget. Approve going past it in the Inbox first
handoff.over_project_daily: This project's daily spending cap is used up, and that account spends on a paid key. Pick a plan or a local model, or wait until the cap resets at midnight

changeAi.title: Change the AI for {{target}}
changeAi.label: Hand off to
changeAi.body: Its work is saved and packaged, and the AI you pick continues from there. That account's spending caps apply.

bar.label: Crew
bar.pending_one: {{count}} new step waits for your approval
bar.pending_other: {{count}} new steps wait for your approval

panel.label: Edit {{target}}
panel.aiHint: Every account scored for this role, best first.
panel.loadError: The candidates could not be read ({{code}})
panel.none: No account fits this role. Add one in Providers, or pick another role.
panel.standbyHint: Drag accounts into the order they take over. Alt+Up and Alt+Down move the focused one.
panel.standbyEmpty: No standby: if this step hits a limit, it waits for you. Drag an account here.
panel.dependsHint: In the graph, drag from a step's right edge to this step's left edge.
panel.pendingNote: This step was added to the running crew. It runs only after you approve it.

addStep.title: Add a step
addStep.proposalNote: The step gets the best account for its role; you can change it before approving.
addStep.followNote: The new step waits for your approval before it runs.

skip.title: Skip {{target}}?
skip.dependents_one: {{steps}} waits for it and will start without its result.
skip.dependents_other: {{steps}} wait for it and will start without its result.

pickAi.title: Change the AI for {{target}}
pickAi.label: Start it on
pickAi.body: The step has not started, so nothing is handed off: it starts on the AI you pick when its turn comes. Nothing starts now.

rerun.title: Run {{target}} again with another AI
rerun.label: Run it on
rerun.body: A follow-up step of the same role goes after this one, on the AI you pick. It waits for your approval like any new step.

changeAll.title: Change the AI for every step
changeAll.label: Use for every step it fits
changeAll.body: Each step this AI is scored for switches to it; a step the independence rule keeps off its model stays as it is. Nothing starts until you approve.
changeAll.already: Every step it fits already uses it

pick.error: The candidates could not be read
pick.none: No other account fits. Add one in Providers.

cancelTask.title: Cancel {{title}}?
cancelTask.body_one: This stops {{count}} open agent run and closes its questions in the Inbox.
cancelTask.body_other: This stops {{count}} open agent runs and closes their questions in the Inbox.
cancelTask.bodyIdle: No agent is running. The task is marked as stopped and its open questions close.
cancelTask.keeps: The worktree stays on disk. Closing a panel never does this; only this button does.

standby.badgeLabel: {{target}}: {{runner}} stands by. Show the standby order
standby.badgeLabelMore_one: {{target}}: {{runner}} and {{count}} more stand by. Show the standby order
standby.badgeLabelMore_other: {{target}}: {{runner}} and {{count}} more stand by. Show the standby order
standby.title: Standby for {{target}}
standby.order: Takes over in this order when the step hits a limit ({{mode}}).
standby.reorderHint: Alt+Up and Alt+Down move the focused one.
standby.locked: This step has started, so its standby order is fixed. A handoff still picks from it.

handoffNow.title: Hand off {{target}} now
handoffNow.body: This answers the limit question in the Inbox: the account you pick continues from the saved work.

why.self: A step cannot wait for itself
why.exists: It already waits for that step
why.approved: This step belongs to the approved crew
why.independence: Step {{step}} would use the same model as step {{other}}
why.read_only_lease: Step {{step}} is read-only but holds the write lease
